segments.text: Ok so this is the State and Actions page for Google ADK, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the shop catalog has cart state here, but there's no ADK backend for it.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
The zod and create generative UI imports weren't on the page, so I added them myself.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for a product card, it should show it with cart state and actions, but the agent just answers in text.
So without ADK agent code, there's no component, no state and no actions.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
